usage: 甲魚 is a noun used to refer specifically to the softshell turtle, a type of reptile.
It can be used as the subject or object in a sentence, for example when talking about eating or seeing a 甲魚.
When describing the turtle living in water, add context words like '水入面' (in the water).
You can combine 甲魚 with verbs like '食' (to eat), '抓' (to catch), or '見到' (to see) to make everyday sentences.
